desc: The booster returning to the tower during Starship flight test 5.

title: File:SpaceX Starbase launch facility (51438071556).jpg
desc: View from across the bay. From left to right: Starship booster, Starship SN20, cryogenic tank bank, "Mechzilla" launch tower.

title: File:Starship SN9 Launch Pad.jpg
desc: Starship SN9 sitting on its launch pad in Starbase. Its construction is more studier than prior prototypes, with a clean look. SN9's forward flaps at the top and aft flaps are closed, in preparation for the 10 kilometer high flight.

title: File:SpaceX Boca Chica Launch Pad - SN9.jpg
desc: SN9 sitting on the launch pad awaiting its test flight, with SN10 under construction in the background at the build site.

title: File:Space X booster Full Stack.jpg
desc: The quick disconnect arm undertaking practice refuelings on the SpaceX Booster 4/Ship 20 stack, four days before their first and only test flight, from South Padre Island, Texas.Creator: Jenny Hautmann for Supercluster

title: File:Full Stack starship.jpg
desc: The SpaceX Starship Booster 7/Ship 24 stack, assembled on the Orbital Launch Mount at Starbase in Boca Chica, Texas, four days before launching on its first test flight, April 16, 2023Creator: Jenny Hautmann for Supercluster

title: File:Tank farm at starbase.jpg
desc: Tanks 5, 7 (holding nitrogen), 2, 6, and 8 (holding water), with two nitrogen filling trucks, a liquid natural gas tanker truck (with grey-green cab) and the Booster 4/Ship 20 stack on Orbital Launch Mount A, three days before the stack’s first and only test flight from Starbase, Texas.Creator: Jenn

title: File:Starship SN9 Launch Pad and Build Site.jpg
desc: Starship SN9 sitting on the launch pad with the build site in the background ahead of its test flight.
